name: Fashion IQ: Interactive Image Retrieval with Natural Language Feedback
description: Fashion IQ is a benchmark for interactive, composed image retrieval based on conversational language feedback. Consisting of 30,134 image-pair feedback triplets across 77,684 catalog images from three clothing categories (dress, toptee, shirt), challenging models to retrieve target images given a reference image and relative modification caption.
